冻结Na32研究与实时Na16分开；仅87份代表原始X/Y经端口复核，不是14,464份完整Y档案或本次Monte Carlo。精度网格的零角误差／[0,0]区间属于锁格；真实浏览器布局、键盘、Worker/CSP、原生下载和完整绘制时延另验。

guides.after: RMSE 是算法误差，RCRB 是界的平方根；不同天线/RF链配置不能直接算作纯算法收益。本站现已实现受限下行两阶段与同X/Y有限网格比较，并用有限X计算实FIM；冻结离线研究不等于作者原Fig.4，固定F/Z未优化通信，上行与硬件仍未实现。

## Dual-array bounded downlink lesson integration (2026-10-13)

The existing `nearfield-double-array-ispac` identity and [downlink/uplink guide](../reading.html#guide-nearfield-double-array-ispac) now connect one [actual finite-X/Y lesson](../dual-array-positioning.html#question), case, unit and registered page. The historical row 3 is superseded only within this bounded milestone by the same-identity JSON record. There remain 35 unique primary papers, 21 guides and zero whole-paper reproductions; current totals are 25 cases, 41 units and 37 pages. Every previous paper identity, algorithm, prerequisite, beginner progression and current/next CRB sequence is preserved. No influence-catalog paper is added, and earlier dated counts remain historical.

The fixed source is [arXiv:2311.07722v1](https://arxiv.org/html/2311.07722v1). The bounded downlink Algorithm 1 uses actual finite complex X/Y, uncentered YYH/T, MUSIC and ordinary a-transpose-X; every range candidate refits unknown complex gain. The project-added joint comparator evaluates every declared two-dimensional candidate on exactly the same X/Y. Finite-X four-real-parameter Fisher information eliminates unknown gain in real parameter space. Conditional CRBs, rank-one flatness, null/nonregular states, noise-only extrema and a separate arbitrary-X exact alias witness remain explicit. No local bound or grid extremum establishes unique detection/localization.

Live defaults are Na16 / Nb6 / NRF4 / q4 / T32, 28 GHz, half-wavelength spacing, P=1, theta=25 degrees, range=.83 m and a 61×61 grid; both coordinates are off-grid. Project-fixed F/Z preserves total finite energy and per-antenna mean power across q1/2/4 but changes the transmitted subspace and actual X/Y. This is not communication-QoS optimization. The [pinned offline evidence](../assets/data/dual-array/historical-statistics.json) uses Na32 / Nb8 / NRF8 / q8 / T64 and 14,464 observations across 29 cells / 31 rows. Loading verifies original bytes, not fresh Monte Carlo. The 87 representative raw observations and precision-grid locking caveat remain separate from the full study identity.

[Independent runtime acceptance](../assets/data/dual-array/RUNTIME-ACCEPTANCE.md) binds unchanged four-file runtime bytes. [Independent lesson acceptance](../assets/data/dual-array/lesson-review/ACCEPTANCE.md) binds producer commit `85456b619eb24fb3309e483862e4477bb6647082`, tree `9f4c392c7e50efe5c335c59e408b3c35ae196e7e`, freeze `183fae1a6f7b536d582595440763a7f57a1aed8b0dcd23e31bbd5a2c4897fbd6`: 33 actual Node Workers, 15 production Blob receipts, 13 distinct records, 11 distinct X/Y pairs and 37,495 independent formula comparisons. Replayed/paired exports are not extra independent observations. Historical evidence and failed attempts retain their original identities.

The six spatial levels, existing guide and five concept nodes expose the new lesson without replacing existing routes. Raw replay consumes stored actual X/Y and clears generating truth; fixed offline source verification does not become a new experiment. Exact original Fig.4 settings, optimized HB/FD, communication/combiner optimization, uplink, hardware and the original full-paper target remain unfinished.
